subject_description: a TV home shopping host shown from the chest up, black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, tiny clip-on microphone on the lapel
initial_pose: body and head turned three quarters to the right, black eyes looking at the camera, both hands raised in front of the chest with the fingertips touching, closed-lip smile
description: keeps smiling while his head slowly turns away from the camera, further and further, past his shoulder until the back of his head faces the camera, the neck twisting unnaturally while the body stays still; then the head keeps turning the same way all the way around until the face looks at the camera again, and he settles back into the starting pose The shoulders stay almost still and never move sideways; the whole body and both hands stay inside the frame.
